newsitem.title: USA: America First funds seek merger, move to REIT.
newsitem.headline: America First funds seek merger, move to REIT.

text.p: Three America First Limited partnerships said Tuesday they have approved a merger plan and will seek permission from unitholders to convert the three into a publicly traded mortgage real estate investment trust.

The partnerships are Partners of America First Participating/Preferred Equity Mortgage Fund Limited Partnership (PREP 1) America First PREP Fund 2 Limited Partnership and America First PREP Fund 2 Pension Series Limited Partnership (Pension).

Following the merger, the new company, America First Mortgage Investments Inc, will convert the limited partnerships' static fixed rate portfolio of mortgage assets into an active growth-oriented entity seeking to increase both assets and earnings, the companies said.

The merger, which is expected to be accomplished on a tax- deferred basis for Unitholders in the Partnerships, provides for an exchange ratio of 1.0 shares of the REIT for each Unit in PREP 1, 1.26 shares for each Unit in PREP 2 and 1.31 shares for each Unit in Pension. The merger plan includes a policy of maintaining the current distribution at essentially the same rate for all stockholders for the 12-month period following the merger, the companies said.

The REIT will have an equity base of about $75 million following the merger and will invest primarily in adjustable-rate mortgage loans and mortgage securities and will operate in a similar manner to a bank or savings and loan institution in its business purpose, strategy and risk profile but without paying federal income taxes, the companies said.
